rows.en: You are taking surprisingly long, for someone of your caliber.
rows.notes: Hidden speaker retained; condescending address to Altair.

rows.en: My deepest apologies.
rows.notes: Meaning: unambiguously an apology to the superior, rather than a possible request to repeat.

rows.en: I shall give you Machine Knights. Use them to capture Dendoh and the Data Weapons.
rows.notes: Machine Knights rendered as plural collective; Data Weapons plural by capture objective.

rows.en: If we leave it unchecked, its power... may grow greater still.
rows.notes: Neutral its keeps the source deictic referent unexpanded.
uncertain: The source's deictic 'that' likely refers to Dendoh or its combined Data Weapon power; its retains this ambiguity.

rows.en: This is not your battle alone. Do not forget that, Altair...
Yes...
...That concludes the development and mass-production plans for the mass-produced Metal Armor, the Dragoon.
rows.notes: Briefing closes prior explanation; mass-produced descriptor retained separately from production plan.

rows.en: So the mass-production system is finally in place?
Yes. Chongqing Base has already begun production of the initial mass-production model.
Head for Chongqing at once and hand over the Dragonar data.
Understood.
Now we can return to our original mission, Lieutenant Douglas.
Yes. Once Dragoons are fully deployed far and wide, our forces can go on the offensive against Giganos.
rows.notes: Meaning: various locations does not specify a country; corrected the geographic narrowing.

rows.en: Then all the trouble we went through to bring those three Dragonars here will have been worthwhile.
Indeed. Wakaba and the others in particular gave us no end of trouble.
rows.notes: Wakaba is Kaine addressed by surname; retain surname.

rows.en: That will end once we reach Chongqing.
rows.notes: Restored that will end as callback to the trouble in row 15.

rows.en: Once we cancel their Dragonar pilot registrations there, those three will be released from duty.
rows.notes: Pilot-registration cancellation releases the three from duty, not the robots.

rows.en: Oh? Lieutenant, are you going to miss those three when you part ways?
Don't be ridiculous. I'll be glad to see them go.
...Captain Bright, may I have a moment?
What is it?
Actually, GEAR headquarters is developing a program to track the Data Weapons...
rows.notes: Trailing ellipsis retained as Vega introduces her request.

rows.en: If possible, I'd like to take Eris and the others back to headquarters for a visit...
rows.notes: Vega requests permission to return with Eris and others; no reversal of request direction.

rows.en: Once the program is complete, finding the Data Weapons will be easier... Very well. You have my permission.
I'm sorry to ask so much of you...
Gulfer hasn't shown up lately, but... shouldn't you take an escort along, just to be safe?
Yes, that's part of the reason... I plan to ask #男愛称, Domon and the others to come with us.
rows.notes: Exact nickname placeholder retained; both named groups represented by and the others.

rows.en: Rain and #女愛称 in particular are also experts in computer technology.
rows.notes: Exact female nickname placeholder retained.

rows.en: I see... Well, do be careful out there.
Yes, I will.
Thank you all for coming.
So, Doctor... how is the tracking program coming along?
rows.notes: Restored question about tracking-program progress.

rows.en: Yes, we've made several improvements to the program Eris developed earlier.
What improvements?
rows.notes: Restored what with question; not a dropped-subject declarative.

rows.en: Tracking the Data Weapons is impossible without a very sophisticated program.
So we sought help from experts in various fields... and made improvements based on their suggestions.
Here is the list of those experts.
Wow...! Dr. Ritsuko Akagi from NERV, and Professor Yumi from the Photon Power Laboratory...
rows.notes: List deliberately remains unfinished; no invented concluding action.

rows.en: Dr. Hibiki from Mutropolis, and Dr. Raizo Kasshu... Even Domon's father?
rows.notes: Dr. Raizo Kasshu is Domon's father, not an additional listed person.

rows.en: Oh, where did this data come from...?
rows.notes: Restored data provenance question from answer in row 41.

rows.en: Ah, that was provided by the Bahbem Foundation.
The Bahbem Foundation... If I remember correctly, they're TERRA's sponsors...
rows.notes: Trailing ellipsis retained while recognizing TERRA sponsor.

rows.en: Yes. They've been researching and analyzing the MU for some time, so their technology is highly advanced.
Then we just need to finish the program ourselves, incorporating these improvements, right?
Yes. Could I ask you to get to work right away?
Yes, understood.
Haaaah!!
rows.notes: Nonlexical martial-arts cry retained.

rows.en: You're still not stepping in deep enough!
rows.notes: Stepping in concerns committed closing distance in sparring.

rows.en: Deyaaaah!!
rows.notes: Nonlexical martial-arts cry retained.

rows.en: You're not reading my moves well enough either!!
rows.notes: Reading refers to anticipating opponent moves during sparring.

rows.en: Uagh!!
rows.notes: Impact cry retained.

rows.en: All right... that's enough for today!
Th-thank you very much!
G-Ginga... are you all right?
rows.notes: Stray closing quote and terminal source break ignored per brief.

rows.en: Yeah, this is nothing. Still, I really can't beat Domon.
No, you've got talent. Keep training like this, and you could become a fine Gundam Fighter.
rows.notes: Praise is directed to Ginga; Gundam Fighter encouragement confirmed by rows 57-59.

rows.en: Huh!? F-for real!?
Yes. So don't neglect your daily training. I'll spar with you again whenever you like.
A G-Gundam Fighter, huh... I wanna try piloting a Mobile Fighter myself someday.
But you... You're piloting Dendoh right now, aren't you? It's a close-combat robot too...
Yeah, that's true. But I wanna be able to take down mobile suits with my bare hands too.
Y-your bare hands? How could anyone do something that crazy...?
rows.notes: Disbelieving question trails off; retains source unfinished possibility.

rows.en: No, it's true.
What!?
I saw it in military footage... Domon's master, Master Asia, has taken down mobile suits with his bare hands.
W-whaaaat!?
No wonder you're surprised. I felt the same way when I first saw it.
I-I can't believe it... To think there's someone who can do that...
rows.notes: Second sentence is a deliberate wondering fragment.

rows.en: Really? I bet Vega could pull it off too.
You're right... She fights Gulfer Machine Beasts and Death Army units on her motorcycle, after all.
If Vega were my mom... maybe I really could become a Gundam Fighter.
rows.notes: Hypothetical about Ginga's own mother; does not expose Vega's actual identity.

rows.en: No way, surely not...
rows.notes: Unfinished disbelief at the hypothetical Vega-as-mother claim; no claim about Vega's physical abilities added.

rows.en: Ginga, Hokuto, thanks for waiting.
Oh? Did you finish that program?
It's about 80% complete for now. I'd like to test it at this stage, so could you lend me your Gear Commanders?
rows.notes: Plural Gear Commanders inferred from both boys handing over controllers.

rows.en: Sure. We just need to let Unicorn and Leo out first, right?
Yes, please do.
rows.notes: Eris asks Hokuto to let the Data Weapons out; request direction preserved.
Leo Circle remains silent across repeated appearances.

rows.en: Okay, I'll start. But Unicorn, Leo... you really mustn't run away, okay?
rows.notes: Addresses the two Data Weapons directly.

rows.en: Aha, they're nodding. All right, I'll load the program.
It's locating them just fine...
If it keeps this up...
rows.notes: Conditional sentence deliberately trails off.

rows.en: Huh!? An error!?
Leo!?
rows.notes: Stray Japanese closing wrapper and trailing break removed.

rows.en: U-Unicorn!
rows.notes: Stray Japanese closing wrapper and trailing break removed.

rows.en: They v-vanished...!? No way!
rows.notes: Plural subject restored: both Leo and Unicorn vanished.

rows.en: Is it a bug!? But Rain, #女愛称 and I checked it over so many times!
rows.notes: Eris includes herself with Rain and the female lead in repeated checks.
Nonverbal alarm punctuation retained.

rows.en: Unidentified objects are approaching Hoshimi Town!
Is it Gulfer!?
No! It's the Death Army!
What!?
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: Chief, we'll head out!
I'm counting on you, Vega! I'll also send the Nahel Argama team a request for help!
rows.notes: Shibuya asks Vega for help, then offers to request reinforcements.

rows.en: Eris! Give me back my Gear Commander!

rows.notes: Interrupted attempt to explain; retains hesitation.

rows.en: The enemy's coming! We've got to hurry and head out!
Ah... w-wait!
We can talk later! Let's go, Hokuto!
Yeah!
rows.notes: Yeah works for readiness at s0210:228 and launch calls at280/326.

rows.en: Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!
uncertain: Source is a defeat cry with no verb ('This me, No. 1 in the Commander Ranking...!'); 'Beaten?!' supplied from the context of a defeat line. 'Commander Ranking' from glossary term [jp].

rows.en: Nuuuoooh! Me... How could I, of all people...?!
uncertain: Source is a bare 'Me... this me?!' defeat cry; 'How could I' supplies the implied disbelief.

rows.en: Rom!!
Mark my words! I shall return!
uncertain: [jp] is English in katakana; rendered as plain English.

rows.en: Lord Gades, I served you faithfully! Why won't you come to save me?!
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'Lord Gades'; assumed the line is addressed to Gades (rescue plea).

rows.en: Ah, no! My Commander Ranking's gonna drop!
uncertain: Kansai-dialect comic line ('[jp]'); dialect conveyed only through casual register.

rows.en: Milady! Master Rom! I am terribly sorry!
uncertain: [jp] = Leina (Jim is Leina's servant) -> 'Milady'; [jp] -> 'Master Rom'.

rows.en: What has justice ever done for me? Justice does nothing for anyone...
uncertain: [jp] object not stated; 'for me' / 'for anyone' chosen.

rows.en: Pass this on! Tell them I fought a battle no martial artist would be ashamed of!
uncertain: [jp] has no stated recipient; kept unnamed ('Tell them'). Likely meant for Rom, not asserted.

rows.en: Brother Rom! I'm sorry!
Wh-wh-whoa! Rooom~!
I'm counting on you to carry on!
uncertain: [jp]: Rom asks the listener (his allies) to take over; listener not named.

rows.en: Unable to continue combat...
They got me?! No way!!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'They got me' (agent unspecified).

rows.en: Ah... Aaah?!
N-no way... Is this as far as I go...?!
Y-you're kidding! Me, of all people?! I can't believe it!
Ugh! I can't be like this... I just can't let it end like this!
uncertain: [jp]: the 'I' is inferred (Asuka berating herself).

rows.en: Yes... That's how it should be......

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled from glossary [jp] = 'Mass-produced EVA'.

rows.en: I'll leave your fate be... for now!
uncertain: [jp] (retreat line): 'I'll hold off on your fate for a while'.

rows.en: Careless of me... Is this the end...?!
Damn, is this as far as I go?!
No...! It can't be, not this!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; [jp] speaker filled as 'Gulfer' (glossary term [jp], do_not_touch). Probably the generic Gulfer soldier unit ([jp] = 'Gulfer Soldier'); kept the shorter in-game label.

rows.en: O-Oyakata-samaaa!
uncertain: [jp] kept as 'Oyakata-sama' per glossary term.

rows.en: Wh-what?! Impossible!!
Th-this can't... This is absurd...!!
It's no good! I have to bail out!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'I' inferred (Kirakuni flies the Cell Fighter; not verified that it is solo).

rows.en: We have to... bail out...!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'We' inferred because Dendoh is co-piloted by Ginga and Hokuto. This line is reused in 3 places (s00r00:32/33/173) and may play when Hokuto is in another unit - check.

rows.en: Is this the end...?!
Nuooooooh!!
It seems retreat is my only choice...!
uncertain: [jp]: subject inferred as 'my' (Vega speaking for herself); could be 'our' if she leads a group.

rows.en: Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor... Please... forgive me...
uncertain: [jp] -> 'Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor' using glossary 'Gulfer Emperor' (note: glossary en_short for that entry is 'Galfa Emperor', inconsistent with en_full/do_not_touch 'Gulfer').

rows.en: B-bailing out~! Ryoko, don't get mad at me, okay?!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; rendered as 'bailing out' (Hikaru herself).

rows.en: Curses...! Hurry, all hands, evacuate!
Dammit! Is this how it ends?!
Wha! This is as far as I go?! How pathetic...!
uncertain: [jp] / [jp]: subject 'I' inferred (Saburota about himself).

rows.en: Yu... Yurika......
In death, none shall gather my bones... To perish is my fate...
uncertain: [jp] is a stock oath phrase ('none will gather the corpse of the fallen'); rendered with 'my' since he is speaking of himself.

rows.en: Omoikane... I'm sorry. All hands, abandon ship!
This is the end... and that's a wrap...
uncertain: [jp] ('end of the scroll' = 'it's all over'); Izumi is a punster, 'that's a wrap' keeps the media idiom.

rows.en: Ngh! Next time, victory will be ours!
Uwaah! Captain, sir!!
uncertain: [jp] = Meio (captain) -> 'Captain, sir'.

rows.en: Dammit, you'll pay for this! You Dragonar scum!!
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'you'll pay for this' (stock threat).

rows.en: Uoooooh?!
D-dammiiiit!!
Take care of my mom for me...!!
uncertain: [jp]: Kaine asks the listener (unnamed) to look after his mother; direction kept as a request.

rows.en: C-Colonel!!
uncertain: [jp] = Gon Jem (colonel).

rows.en: What?! Waaaah!!
It's no good! I'm bailing out!!
C-Captain, sirrr!
uncertain: [jp] = Meio.

rows.en: As long as I live, the Giganos Empire shall never fall...!
uncertain: [jp] literally 'as long as I am here'; 'as long as I live' chosen.

rows.en: Heh, so this is as far as I go...
Tch, that's all for today!
uncertain: [jp]: impersonal 'that's all for today' kept (Min retreating).

rows.en: Sorry! This is as far as I go!
Am I going down...?!
Ngh, how could this...
uncertain: [jp]… trails off in the source; kept the omission.

rows.en: Ah, no...!
Waaaah!! I-it's no good~
Judau! They got me!
No no no no!
Dammit! Sorry, I'm bailing out!
D-damn! They got me!
This is... the end...
N-no good! I've been hit!
Big brother...!
uncertain: Leina's brother is Judau; kept as 'Big brother' rather than naming him, matching the source.

rows.en: Aah, why did this happen to me of all people!?
uncertain: Source is the fragment 'why this me!?' (nande kono atashi ga); restored a verb ('happen to me').

rows.en: No good! I'm bailing out!
My unit's already done for!? Amuro...!
uncertain: Source 'mou kitai ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'already done for' (unit destroyed).

rows.en: So this is it... All hands, evacuate!
I... I lost...!
uncertain: Source 'maketa no ka' has no subject; restored 'I' (Argo about himself).

rows.en: Ugh! D-Domon!!
Hahaha... It's no use! You have no chance of winning...
You lot are finished no matter whaaat!
Splendid... Gwaaah!!
Ugh... ugh... I... I lost...!
uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary (speaker_jp is the short form 'Saishi').

rows.en: Ugh, guh, ah, aaaagh!
Alas... My fate, too, ends here...
Jeeesus! You gotta be kidding me!
Graaaaaah!!
Brrrrrr...
uncertain: Horse noise (Fuunsaiki); kept as 'Brrrrrr...'.

rows.en: Waaaaagh!
D-Domooon!!
You'd better remember this, you bastard!
Wh-whoa-whoaaa~
uncertain: Boss's comic exclamation 'arryaryaaan' has no fixed English; rendered as a goofy 'Wh-whoa-whoaaa~'.

rows.en: Noooo~! Koji~!
Daaamn iiit!
I'm bailing out!
Oh, come on. Whoa!?
Oh well. I'm counting on you for the rest, everyone.
uncertain: Direction: 'ato wa tanomu ze, minna' = Hayato asking everyone to handle the rest.

rows.en: Kyaaaah! Ryo! Hayato! Benkei!
rows.notes: Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full [jp] remains Ryoma.
uncertain: Source says 'Ryou-kun' (nickname for Ryoma). No glossary entry for the nickname; used glossary short name 'Ryoma'. Could be 'Ryo' if the project prefers nicknames. Honorific -kun dropped.

rows.en: Don't think this means you've won!
E-Emperor Burai!
Getter's power is... Dammit!
uncertain: Kept the source's cut-off: 'Getter's power is...' (predicate omitted in JP, deliberately unfinished).

rows.en: J-Juniooor~!
uncertain: Zuril cries out 'Junior'; glossary has the unit 'Zuril Jr.'. Referent inferred to be his Zuril Jr.; kept as 'Junior' since that is what he shouts.

rows.en: King Vegaaaa!
uncertain: 'Vega Daiou-sama': honorific -sama not rendered separately; 'King' carries it.

rows.en: I am the king of the universe, King Vegaaa!
Kyaaaah! Kojiii!!
Kyaaaah!
Damn, I got careless! Me, of all people!
U-urgh... Jigajiga... Is this as far as we go...!
uncertain: 'Jigajiga' = his Vega Beast (glossary: Vega Beast Jigajiga). Restored subject 'we' (Mors + Jigajiga).

rows.en: I'm counting on you all to protect the Earth!
uncertain: Direction: Duke asking the others (kimitachi de) to protect Earth.

rows.en: Kyaaah!! Daisuke!
uncertain: Honorific -san dropped.

rows.en: Ooooh! Ugwaaaaaagh~!
I'm sorry... Miku...
Nuooooooh!!
No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Source 'masaka, Zeorymer ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'is going down' (unit-destroyed line).

rows.en: No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Same line as 363 (Masaki instead of Masato); same inferred predicate.

rows.en: Impossible...! Omzack... my "Lightning"!
uncertain: Glossary unit is 'Omzack of the Lightning' (character entry for Saiga says 'Thunder'); used 'Lightning' to match the unit name.

rows.en: Tau... I'm sorry... I... you...!
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Aen' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Aen'; glossary only has the full form). Kept source omission 'watashi wa... anata wo...!' (no verb); the intended verb is not settled out of context. 'Tau' used bare as in source; glossary full name Shi-Tau.

rows.en: Big sister...
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Tau' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Tau').

rows.en: Y-Yuratei...
...I was careless... I... have lost...
Saiga... I... end here...
uncertain: Source 'watashi wa... koko de...' omits the verb; inferred 'end here' (dying/defeat).

rows.en: Damn... A lifelong disgrace for Kyoshiro Yuzuki!
Damn!! It's no good!
Ugh! I've been hit!?
Kyaaaah!!
Not yet! Raideen! Whoa!
This... can't be...!
Damn, it's no good!!
Waaaaaah!!
Eek!! No...!! It can't be!!
Ah! Is this the end!?
Kyaaah!!
Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Waaaaaah!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary.

rows.en: Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Uwaaagh!
uncertain: JP raw line lacks the closing bracket; translated the body only.

rows.en: 1. Destroy all enemies.
rows.notes: Player; victory objective; no dialogue referent. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: 1. Any allied unit is shot down.
rows.notes: Listener: player. Loss condition, plain text; preserves one line and the any-one-allied-unit trigger.

rows.en: Death Army units are entering Hoshimi Town!
They're here...!
They're all the usual drones...
rows.notes: Generic remote Death Army units, with no larger heat source nearby.
uncertain: Generic remote-unit wording: drones chosen contextually for terminal units; no fixed glossary label.

rows.en: Are there any large heat signatures nearby?
No, none.
What on earth are they after...?
Last time, they were after the Star of Ra Mu, but...
rows.notes: Trailing contrast connects to row105.

rows.en: This time, they may be targeting the Data Weapons.

rows.notes: Nonverbal alarm punctuation retained.

rows.en: W-what did you say!?
Are the Data Weapons something DG Cells can absorb?
rows.notes: Explicit Data Weapons referent restored from preceding exchange.

rows.en: DG Cells also behave like a computer virus... so that's very likely.
rows.notes: Absorption likelihood answers row108, rather than a new virus claim.

rows.en: N-no way! I'm not letting those things take my Leo!

rows.notes: Nonverbal anxious silence retained.

rows.en: But we can't just fight without the Data Weapons!
Ginga, let's use Leo Circle to wipe out the enemy in one go!

rows.notes: Thought reaction; actual thought fitting required.

rows.en: All right! We'll strike first and win!
W-wait!
Leo Drive! Instaaall!!
rows.notes: Leo Drive activation; stretched Install shout retained. Existing campaign term has no independently established canonical English provenance.
uncertain: Leo Drive has source-based campaign spelling but no independent canonical English provenance.

rows.en: Huh!?
What are you doing, Ginga!?
I-I plugged the Gear Commander in properly!
Forget it! I'll do it!
Unicorn Drive! Instaaaaall!!
rows.notes: Literal Unicorn Drive activation call; extended install shout preserved. Root centrally approved command form; Drive remains distinct from Drill.
uncertain: Independent canonical English provenance remains unestablished; root approved direct English-form activation command from source.

rows.en: System error!?
I-I knew it...!
rows.notes: Eris recognizes the bug consequence; restored first-person thought.

rows.en: Hokuto, what about the Data Weapons!?
rows.notes: Question concerns the absent Data Weapons, not an instruction to deploy them.

rows.en: A-aah!!
What's wrong, Ginga!?
D-Domon! My Leo's gone from the Gear Commander!
What!?
M-my Unicorn's gone too!!
rows.notes: Restored Hokuto's missing Unicorn from s0270:232 and 238-240.

rows.en: Are you saying the Data Weapons escaped from the Gear Commanders!?
What!? What's going on!?
Could that tracking program from earlier have caused this!?
rows.notes: Restored tracking program as possible cause from Eris's following admission.

rows.en: Y-yes... It's my fault...! The tracking program had a bug, and when I ran it...
rows.notes: Source trails off after the consequence of running the bugged program; unfinished ending retained.

rows.en: A bug... No way! We checked it too!
H-how are you going to fix this!? Where did my Leo go!?
...I'm sorry...
Sorry won't cut it, you idiot!
I know... I know what a terrible mistake I made... But I... But I...!
rows.notes: Eris knows her own mistake; repeated unfinished self-defense retained. Meaning review removed invented past-tense verb from the unfinished self-defense.

rows.en: Ginga, she didn't do it on purpose. We have to defeat those guys first.
rows.notes: She refers to Eris; sourced gender in glossary.

rows.en: That's right! We can figure out what to do afterward!
O-okay.

rows.notes: Silence shared by s0270:254 and i027a:34; fits both shame and withdrawal after the later mission discussion.

rows.en: We'll be in trouble if Ogre shows up here! Domon, #男愛称, let's handle the enemy ourselves!
rows.notes: Vega asks Domon and the male lead to join her in engaging the enemy; exact male nickname placeholder preserved.

rows.en: Yeah!
Roger!
Answer me! What do you plan to do once you have Dendoh and the Data Weapons!?
You disappoint me, Domon Kasshu, was it...?
rows.notes: Altair dismissively repeats Domon's name with to yara; not literal ignorance of identity. Meaning review replaces invented whoever-you-are wording.

rows.en: If you're a warrior too, win the answers you seek with your own hands!
Fine! I'll smash that face of yours with my fist!
Oh... A fine horse. Will you let me ride on your back?
rows.notes: Altair addresses Fuunsaiki; riding request direction preserved.
Horse's punctuation-only reaction retained, no invented spoken words.

rows.en: Heh... So I must defeat your master before my wish can come true...
rows.notes: Altair must defeat the horse's master to fulfill his own wish to ride.

rows.en: Very well! I'll defeat Domon Kasshu and take you as my own beloved steed!
You must be eager to die, coming at me in a machine like that!
rows.notes: Separate battle-event taunt at Kirakuni, not continuation of horse conversation.

rows.en: I won't let you! I'll defeat you and go rescue Ginga and Hokuto!
Get out of the way! Ginga and Hokuto are getting away!!
rows.notes: Immediate following Altair reply identifies the pair leaving as the enemies' objective; direction retained without inventing a destination.

rows.en: That is precisely our aim. If you want to pass, defeat me and Ogre first.
Though you'll be the one left crawling on the ground!
This reading! The Data Weapons were nearby!?
rows.notes: Reading is of the escaped Data Weapons, resolved by Kirakuni's question and Eris's reply.

rows.en: Is it the Data Weapons!?
Yes, they're to the west!
Unicorn! And Leo!
rows.notes: Short names Unicorn and Leo retained rather than expanding to complete weapon names.

rows.en: So that's where they've been!
I thought they'd fled much farther away...!
What are you talking about!? This is lucky!
So far, the Data Weapons have appeared at Zeorymer's base and Tokyo-3, where the Angel appeared...
rows.notes: Eris recalls two earlier locations; final ellipsis retained, thought kind preserved.

rows.en: Both places had powerful energy emissions. Does that mean Hoshimi Town has them too?
rows.notes: Eris infers local energy emissions from both previous appearances; question retains hypothesis rather than asserting fact.

rows.en: Ginga, let's save Unicorn and Leo again while we have the chance!
rows.notes: Save is technical retrieval/storage action, not an idiomatic rescue.

rows.en: Okay! They're over there, right!?
rows.notes: Ginga confirms the Data Weapons' visible location.

rows.en: Both of you! Leave the enemies to us and hurry!
rows.notes: Male lead offers coverage to both boys; direction preserved.

rows.en: Yeah!
Yes!
rows.notes: Neutral enthusiastic Yes suitable both encouragement use760 and launch order use901.

rows.en: 1. Destroy all enemies.@2. GEAR Fighter Dendoh reaches the destination.
rows.notes: Mission objectives; one explicit break retained.

rows.en: I kept you waiting, Leo, Unicorn!
rows.notes: Addresses Leo and Unicorn using source nicknames.

rows.en: Ginga! Hokuto! Perform File Save right away!
rows.notes: Vega directs both pilots to recapture the Data Weapons.

rows.en: I know that!
Multiple objects are rapidly approaching from above!
What!?
Could it be the Gulfer?!
rows.notes: Vega asks if it is Gulfer.

rows.en: W-we're surrounded!?
What the hell are these things!?
These aren't the usual Machine Beasts...! They're humanoid!
! They've sent in Machine Knights!?
More objects are descending! There are two of them!
O-Ogre!!
rows.notes: Stammered name exclamation retained.

rows.en: Damn it! Why did it have to show up now of all times!?
rows.notes: Subject restored: Ogre has arrived at the worst time.

rows.en: But the report said two...! Where's the other one!?
rows.notes: Two arrivals reported; second is revealed as Michelo.

rows.en: Oh... So the Data Weapons are separated from Dendoh.
But it doesn't look like they've been File Loaded...
rows.notes: Data Weapons are separated without File Load; passive they refers to the Data Weapons, avoiding a mistaken claim that the weapons operate the command.
uncertain: File Load is source-backed; an independent licensed English command label remains unestablished.

rows.en: Without the Data Weapons, you can't stand up to Ogre! Hokuto! Ginga! You have to run now!!
rows.notes: Vega urges the pilots to escape Ogre.

rows.en: You say run, but where are we supposed to go!?
Heh heh heh... Whatever the reason, this works in my favor.
I won't let you do that!!
rows.notes: Domon intervenes against Altair; restored the object/action in the English clause.

rows.en: Hold it, you bastard!! I'M the one you're fighting!!
rows.notes: Hidden speaker remains ???; coarse challenge directed at Domon.
Punctuation-only shock retained at BOTH s0270:308 and s0270:337.

rows.en: You! Michelo Chariot!!
Hyahahahaha! It's been a while, Domon Kasshu!
N-no way! Have they come back to life!?
rows.notes: Plural they retained: Rain recognizes the resurrected Devil Gundam agents.

rows.en: Who is he!?
A year ago, he was infected with DG Cells and became the Devil Gundam's pawn...! He's one of the Devil Gundam's Four Heavenly Kings!
rows.notes: Male referent is Michelo, verified in glossary.

rows.en: Sai Saici defeated you in the final battle on Lantau Island...!
Yeah, that's right... That's how it went...! But I've come back from hell to take you bastards down!!
They... seem to be beings much like us Gulfer.
That doesn't mean I came here to make friends with you!
Then tell me, what is your purpose?
I came to steal those things you call Data Weapons! Hyahahaha!!
W-what did you say!?
Why does he want the Data Weapons!?
rows.notes: Missing desire/action restored from Michelo's theft declaration.

rows.en: I-it seems your prediction was correct, Rain...!
rows.notes: Answers Rain's prediction at s0270:214-219 that DG forces seek Data Weapons.

rows.en: Y-yes...!
Now! If you value your lives, hand over the Data Weapons!!
Fool... The likes of you could never handle these creatures.
rows.notes: These refers to living Data Weapons, not Machine Knights.

rows.en: Besides, my purpose this time is to capture Dendoh.
Machine Knights! Seize Dendoh!
Oh no!!
Let us go! Let go, you bastards!!
rows.notes: Plural captors established by Machine Knights seizing Dendoh.

rows.en: Now, take it straight to Spiral Castle.
rows.notes: It refers to captured Dendoh; orders are directed to Machine Knights.

rows.en: Oh no!!
H-Hokuto! Ginga!!
We're going after them, #男愛称!!
rows.notes: Domon asks male protagonist to pursue captured Dendoh and the boys.

rows.en: Yeah!!
I won't let you go! You'll have to face me!
Th-the Data Weapons!!
rows.notes: Interrupted exclamation retained; departure supplied by following reactions.

rows.en: Tch! The bastards got away!!
Heh... They've gone after their masters. All the better for me.
rows.notes: Plural masters refers to Hokuto and Ginga.

rows.en: Now that they're gone, there's no point in staying here! Domon Kasshu! We'll settle this another time!!
rows.notes: They are Data Weapons; withdrawal postpones duel.

rows.en: Michelo...!!
rows.notes: Name-only exclamation retained.

rows.en: ...Now the nuisance is gone. What will you do, martial artist of Earth?
rows.notes: Nuisance refers to departing Michelo.

rows.en: Isn't it obvious!?
rows.notes: Answers Altair's challenge; the actual action follows in next row.

rows.en: I'll defeat you and get Hokuto and Ginga back!!
Heh... Then let me hear your name before we fight.
When you ask someone's name, give your own name first!
Hmph, I see. A petty point to insist on, but very well...
My name is Altair. Altair, the Black Knight of Gulfer.
The Undefeated of the East's foremost disciple... The Shuffle Alliance's King of Hearts! Domon! I am Domon Kasshu!!
rows.notes: Full boast preserves title, foremost-disciple claim, alliance and repeated self-introduction.

rows.en: Then here I come, Domon Kasshu!!
Come on, Altair!!
You're good...! But I've already accomplished my objective here. We'll settle this duel another time!!
rows.notes: Altair postpones the duel; he does not concede defeat.

rows.en: Wait, Altair!!
It's no use! We can't catch him at that speed...!
D-damn it! I can't believe we couldn't save those two!!

uncertain: Silent ……… rendered '...'. The line is reused in i00r0a:3/16/62/97 (the interlude), so it is a neutral silence.

rows.en: H-how could this happen...! Gulfer has taken Dendoh...!
Ginga... Hokuto...!
! The Nahel Argama...
rows.notes: Retained startled exclamation and ship-name fragment.

rows.en: Everyone! What happened to Dendoh... to Hokuto and Ginga!?
Those two... Gulfer took them away.
W-what!? Even with you there to protect them...!
rows.notes: Retained accusatory trailing fragment: Koji blames the team that was present.

rows.en: ...I'm sorry.
Y-you think an apology is enough!?
Stop it, Koji. It isn't their fault... We share the blame for not getting here in time.
rows.notes: Duke includes his own late-arriving group in responsibility.

rows.en: Ugh...!
Let's think about how we can save Hokuto and Ginga instead...
Y-yeah...
...We just received footage from a Federation military reconnaissance satellite.
The footage confirms that Dendoh has been taken to the Moon's restricted zone... to Spiral Castle.
rows.notes: Satellite footage establishes certainty and destination, not merely a guess.

rows.en: Oh, no...!
Captain Bright! Please let me go to the Moon right away... to save Hokuto, Ginga and the deputy commander!
rows.notes: Kirakuni asks Bright for permission to go rescue all three; deputy commander is Vega.

uncertain: Rendered the source's long silence as '...'.

rows.en: Captain!
Kirakuni, I understand how you feel... but it would be too much for you alone.
rows.notes: Ignored stray closing wrapper and trailing source break.

rows.en: The three of them were taken to Spiral Castle... the enemy's headquarters.
Even so, we can't just sit here and do nothing!
But... we have a mission to transport the Dragonars to Chongqing.
We must transfer Wakaba's team's data to the Dragoon and start mass production now, or it could change the course of the war.
rows.notes: Wakaba refers to Kaine and his Dragonar teammates; retained surname address. Measured 4-line overflow compressed to 3 lines; urgency, data transfer, production and war consequence retained.

rows.en: But if Dendoh and the Data Weapons fall completely into Gulfer's hands, the Earth itself...!
rows.notes: Retained deliberate unfinished consequence concerning Earth.

rows.en: ...What will you do, Captain?
I have an idea. Captain Katsuragi, have everyone assemble in the briefing room.
rows.notes: Captain Katsuragi follows glossary rank for source [jp].

rows.en: Understood, sir.
There was a bug in the tracking program?
Y-yes...
And it wasn't an accident... Someone put it there deliberately.
Someone did it deliberately?
rows.notes: Ignored stray closing wrapper and trailing source break.

rows.en: Yes... Though we still don't know which data caused it...
rows.notes: Retained trailing qualification; source does not identify the culprit data.

rows.en: There was a mechanism that forcibly released the Data Weapons from the Commanders as soon as we loaded the program...
rows.notes: Retained trailing explanation; Commanders are Gear Commander devices, not military officers. Kept the source-short Commander term rather than adding Gear.
uncertain: Source does not mark device number; plural Commanders is inferred from the two Dendoh pilots and their devices.

rows.en: The three of you didn't even notice it... Whoever did it must have been very clever.
rows.notes: The three listeners are Eris, Rain and the female lead, who investigated the software.

rows.en: What's more, releasing the Data Weapons would be utterly impossible without highly advanced technology.
Who on earth would do such a thing...?
...There's one thing I do know.
Huh?
rows.notes: Context settled from the original neighboring dialogue; complete spoken subject/action retained.

rows.en: Whoever planted that bug must have some connection to Michelo Chariot.
Probably. We can assume he attacked knowing the Data Weapons would be released.
rows.notes: He refers to Michelo, named in the preceding row.

rows.en: Good grief... It sounds like there's a lot more to this story.
It's my fault... It's because of me that Ginga, Hokuto and Vega...
rows.notes: Retained self-blaming trailing fragment with all three captives named.

rows.en: It isn't just your fault, Eris. We share the blame, too.
Yeah... If only I hadn't let Michelo catch me off guard...
rows.notes: Retained counterfactual trailing fragment with Domon as subject.

rows.en: For now, like Daisuke said, we should think about what to do next.
rows.notes: Daisuke is Duke, whose rescue-first advice appears in owner row251.

rows.en: It sounds like they'll be announcing our next operation soon.
I see... I understand your situation.
Then, may I ask you to do that for us?
rows.notes: Bright asks Misumaru to arrange assistance; following rows confirm reinforcements.

rows.en: Yes. I intended to have them join your unit soon in any case.
rows.notes: Misumaru grants Bright reinforcements; they are the Nadesico crew, whose later rescue-carrier assignment settles the referent.

rows.en: However, they have a mission of their own to carry out.
rows.notes: Misumaru warns Bright that the reinforcements retain their own mission.

rows.en: Once Dendoh has been rescued, I will have them resume it... Is that acceptable?
rows.notes: Misumaru will let the Nadesico crew resume their other mission after the rescue; asks Bright if that is acceptable.

rows.en: Understood, sir.
rows.notes: Bright formally acknowledges Misumaru; ignores source stray closing wrapper and trailing break.

rows.en: Then I will send them to Hoshimi Town at once.
rows.notes: Misumaru sends the reinforcements to the current Hoshimi Town location.

rows.en: I'm worried... about Ginga and the others...
rows.notes: Ple voices concern to Leina about Ginga and the other captives; subject restored.

rows.en: Yeah... I just hope they're all safe somehow...
rows.notes: Leina answers Ple; they means Ginga and the other captives.

rows.en: Everyone's here, I see.
rows.notes: Misato gathers the assembled pilots for the operational briefing.

rows.en: Misato, have you reached a decision?
rows.notes: Asuka asks Misato whether command has decided what to do.

rows.en: Yes. Captain Bright will explain it to you now.
rows.notes: Misato refers the assembled team to Bright; Captain retained; stray source wrapper ignored.

rows.en: I will now brief everyone on our upcoming operations.
rows.notes: Bright introduces the upcoming-operation briefing in officer register.

rows.en: To rescue Dendoh, which was taken to the Spiral Castle on the Moon, and transport the Dragonars to Chongqing Base...
rows.notes: Bright starts a purpose clause completed by 299; Dendoh is captive at the lunar Spiral Castle; both rescue and Dragonar delivery retained.

rows.en: We will divide our forces into two groups.
rows.notes: Bright completes the 298 announcement: the forces will divide into two.

rows.en: I see... So we'll carry out both operations at the same time.
rows.notes: Hayato recognizes the two operations will run simultaneously.

rows.en: But what about our battleships? The Nahel Argama is the only one our unit has right now...
rows.notes: Judau raises the lack of a second carrier; Nahel Argama is their only ship at present.

rows.en: Yeah. It'd be a different story if the Nadesico came to help us.
rows.notes: Beecha suggests Nadesico reinforcements would solve the ship shortage; hypothetical retained.

rows.en: Exactly, Beecha. The Nadesico will arrive here in Hoshimi Town shortly.
rows.notes: Bright confirms the reinforcements to Beecha; Nadesico is coming here to Hoshimi Town.

rows.en: Really?!
rows.notes: Beecha reacts with surprised question/exclamation.

rows.en: Yes. It will serve as the Dendoh rescue team's carrier and head for the Moon.
rows.notes: Bright explains the Nadesico rescue-carrier assignment and lunar destination.

rows.en: The Nahel Argama will head for Chongqing to transport the Dragonars.
rows.notes: Bright explains the Nahel Argama Dragonar transport assignment and Chongqing destination.

rows.en: Now I'll announce who's assigned to each team.
rows.notes: Misato introduces specific team assignments.

rows.en: By the way, I'll only say this once, so if you don't trust your memory, be sure to take notes.
rows.notes: Misato lightly warns that she will announce each team only once; note-taking instruction conditional on memory retained.

rows.en: Crap, I didn't bring anything to write with.
rows.notes: Kaine regrets having no note-taking supplies; colloquial Crap matches urgency; no new named object introduced.

rows.en: Then you'd better burn it into your brain.
rows.notes: Tapp tells Kaine to memorize the briefing.

rows.en: ...First, those heading to the Spiral Castle on the Moon with the Nadesico B are...
rows.notes: Misato starts lunar-team list, completed in 312; unfinished are... retained.

rows.en: The Gundam Team, Domon and Rain, Kirakuni, Eris and the others.
rows.notes: Misato gives the lunar-team list: Gundam Team, Domon, Rain, Kirakuni, Eris and others. List fragment follows the previous introduction.

rows.en: T-that's all?!
rows.notes: Mondo reacts to the small lunar force; stutter retained.

rows.en: I-isn't that a little short on firepower?
rows.notes: Elle also questions the small force; stutter and question retained.

rows.en: That's because I gave priority to units that excel at space combat.
rows.notes: Misato explains she prioritized space-capable units.

rows.en: And your mission is strictly to rescue Dendoh... You are not to destroy the Spiral Castle itself.
rows.notes: Misato narrows the operation to Dendoh rescue and explicitly excludes destroying the Spiral Castle.

rows.en: So if we all went in a big crowd, we'd just draw more attention...
rows.notes: Beecha infers a large group would attract attention; conditional we restored.

rows.en: Well, why don't we think of ourselves as a small elite team?
rows.notes: Judau reframes the lunar team as an elite force; inclusive ourselves reflects the Gundam Team assignment.

rows.en: ...Next, I'll announce the team heading to Chongqing aboard the Nahel Argama.
rows.notes: Misato turns to the Nahel Argama Chongqing team.

rows.en: First, the Dragonar Team, the Mazinger Team, the Getter Team, Raideen, all the EVA units, and...
rows.notes: Misato lists Earth-bound groups, Raideen, and all EVA units; unfinished and... continues in 321.

rows.en: RahXephon, which is scheduled to join us tomorrow.
rows.notes: Misato completes the list with RahXephon, due tomorrow; deliberate list fragment.

rows.en: So, roughly speaking, the mobile suit team goes to the Moon, and...
rows.notes: Judau summarizes the lunar group as the mobile suit team; trails into Akira response 323.

rows.en: The super robot team goes to Chongqing, then?
rows.notes: Akira completes the contrast: super robots go to Chongqing. Complete subject/verb restored.

rows.en: That's how it works out.
rows.notes: Misato confirms the rough grouping.

rows.en: And Second Lieutenant #男愛称... Since you have a mission to pursue the Medius Locus...
rows.notes: Misato addresses Second Lieutenant Hugo using the exact runtime nickname; plural you includes the protagonist team. Since-clause continues in 326.

rows.en: I'll leave it to you to decide which team to join.
rows.notes: Misato allows the protagonist to choose a route because of the Medius Locus pursuit mission.

rows.en: So will I. I'm fine with whichever you choose, #男愛称.
rows.notes: Aqua agrees to follow Hugo decision; exact male nickname preserved; her subject and assent restored.

rows.en: @Go to Chongqing@Go to the Moon
rows.notes: Plain player choice menu with initial blank segment, Chongqing first and Moon second; two breaks retained.

rows.en: We're responsible for what happened to Dendoh too. So...
rows.notes: Earth-choice exchange: Hugo starts to argue shared responsibility for Dendoh, then trails off before Domon intervenes.

rows.en: No. You should carry out your own mission.
rows.notes: Domon tells Hugo to pursue his own mission.

rows.en: Domon...!
rows.notes: Hugo emotional name-only response is intentionally a fragment.

rows.en: The Medius Locus last appeared in Kyoto...
rows.notes: Domon recalls the Medius Locus previous appearance in Kyoto.

rows.en: So isn't it likely to still be down on Earth now?
rows.notes: Domon infers Medius Locus is likely on Earth; it refers to the preceding unit/target, avoiding a guessed person gender.

rows.en: Leave Ginga, Hokuto and Vega to us. We'll rescue them, I promise.
rows.notes: Domon offers his own team as the rescue party for Ginga, Hokuto and Vega and promises success.

rows.en: ...All right.
rows.notes: Hugo accepts Domon suggestion after a pause.

rows.en: We're responsible for what happened to Dendoh too...
rows.notes: Moon-choice private thought: Hugo still feels shared responsibility for Dendoh; fitted as thought. Source stray wrapper/break ignored.

rows.en: Besides... Albero Esto made contact with Giganos. There's a good chance he's gone into space too...
rows.notes: Hugo private thought considers a different possibility: Albero contacted Giganos and may now be in space. He refers to Albero; sourced glossary gender male.

rows.en: Captain Katsuragi, we'll head for the Moon.
rows.notes: Hugo addresses Misato as Captain Katsuragi, matching glossary rank, and states the protagonist team will go to the Moon.

rows.en: Understood.
rows.notes: Misato acknowledges the Moon choice.

rows.en: ...I'm counting on you, Domon. Make sure you rescue Hokuto, Ginga, Vega and the others.
rows.notes: Kaine requests Domon rescue Hokuto, Ginga, Vega and others; I am counting on you retains the speaker-to-listener request.

rows.en: Yes, I know. You all keep your guard up until you reach Chongqing too.
rows.notes: Domon acknowledges Kaine and warns the Chongqing team not to relax before arrival.

rows.en: Eris, don't put too much pressure on yourself, okay?
rows.notes: Sayaka reassures Eris not to overburden herself; speaker/listener clear.

rows.en: Yes. Besides... If the famous Lieutenant Commander Ruri Hoshino and the Nadesico B are coming to help, I think we'll manage.
rows.notes: Eris answers Sayaka; confidence derives from well-known Ruri Hoshino and Nadesico B reinforcements. Naval rank uses glossary Lieutenant Commander.
uncertain: The source [jp] is read as recognition of well-known Ruri; famous makes this shading explicit. [jp] follows the sourced glossary naval rank Lieutenant Commander rather than army Major.

rows.en: I expect each of you to give it your all. That is all. Dismissed.
rows.notes: Bright expects everyone best efforts, then dismisses the assembly.

context_review.note: Reviewed 157 reused rows: 143 generic defeat rows exactly match reviewed Stage 13, fourteen special rows checked in every original numeric-use window, including route-choice silence and two Data Weapon silences. Read all 345 fresh English lines and six fresh uncertainty flags against context; retained hidden referent, drones interpretation, literal drive/load labels, inferred controller plurality and Ruri recognition/rank decision. Objective/menu breaks preserved, Earth/Moon branch directions distinct. Only262 compressed after measured overflow, preserving urgent data transfer, mass production and war consequence.
